category_title: Students with situational noncompliance in low-engagement settings
scenario_title: Whole-class synonym lesson with computer distractions
minimal_context: The student is supposed to be participating in a whole-class lesson on synonyms but is distracted by a computer in the loud classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, please sit down so we can start our whole-class lesson on synonyms.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ignores the instruction and walks away from the group)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Kanita, we are doing synonyms right now. Please come back.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits down at the computer and opens up Math Corner instead of joining the lesson)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Kanita, do not do Math Corner on the computer right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am going to do it anyway.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, please sit down so we can start our whole-class lesson on synonyms.

STUDENT: (Ignores the instruction and walks away from the group)

TUTOR: Kanita, we are doing synonyms right now. Please come back.

STUDENT: (Sits down at the computer and opens up Math Corner instead of joining the lesson)

TUTOR: Kanita, do not do Math Corner on the computer right now.

STUDENT: I am going to do it anyway.

context.environment: Loud as she tries to talk over the noise in the class
context.social_setting: Whole class with students at the computer requesting help and other distractions occurring

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Someone tells the teacher that Kanita is doing Math Corner on the computer and the teacher tells her not to
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Kanita replies she is going to do it anyway
related_quotes: she is going to do it anyway

behavior_patterns.condition: During first grade following a transition from kindergarten
